description: S458: the §53.2.1 range form `number(0 < value < 10)` is read (it used to resolve to an untyped annotation — no check and no diagnostic). The literal 20 fails `value < 10`, so the static zone fires E-CONTRACT-001.
rationale: §53.2.1: `comparison-predicate = ... | numeric-literal comparison-op "value" comparison-op numeric-literal`; §53.11: E-CONTRACT-001 when a literal demonstrably fails the predicate.
